sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and possess a strong underlying record (7 wins, 1 draw, 2 losses), so this fixture against bottom-placed Alsager—who have managed just 1 win all season—presents an opportunity to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second on 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a key midtable battle. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19pts) host Eccleshall (5th, 18pts) in a direct clash between promotion-form sides, with both teams showing recent wins. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19pts) face Wednesfield Community away; Casuals are in form with back-to-back wins. Bilston Town (6th, 17pts) travel to Foley Meir in another upper-table encounter. Barnton host Shawbury United—Shawbury are in dire straits with six consecutive losses and a single point from their last five games, while Barnton have been steadier with recent wins. Market Drayton (10th) visit New Mills (8th) in a fixture between mid-table sides, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town, two struggling sides near the bottom. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Brereton are struggling with recent losses and Widnes remain rock-bottom with just 2 points all season. Finally, Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a clash of sides around the lower third.
